results.title: Ti Blan
results.overview: After being sent to live with his estranged grandmother, a troubled Haitian-American teen must navigate family expectations, unfamiliar culture, and the burden of a struggling family restaurant, while a looming debt threatens the new path he’s fighting to forge.

results.title: Bulls
results.overview: Two down-on-their-luck half-brothers run a failing dive bar in Indiana and get a shot at taking on England’s elite darts champions.

results.title: Spectrum is 20: The Death and Life of New Captain Scarlet
results.original_title: Spectrum is 20: The Death and Life of New Captain Scarlet
results.overview: Featuring new interviews with key cast and crew, and drawing on a wealth of unseen archive materials, this comprehensive retrospective explores the genesis, production and legacy of the series like never before.

results.title: The Male Gaze: Wild Youth
results.overview: Witness how human nature can reveal that there are forces within us that are either challenged by - or reflected in - the people and environments that surround us in these five short films from around the world that take a closer look at the gay experience.

results.title: Tales of the Underworld
results.overview: A series of short films that create an anthology of stories that will be interlinked to create a feature film. These stories in turn are linked to the 2019 film Lucas and Albert and the follow-up film Babysitters.

results.title: Goodbye Sisters
results.overview: The journey begins in vibrant, spiritual yet harsh Kathmandu and continues towards the majestic Himalayas. Twenty-one-year-old Jamuna accompanies her younger sister on what could be their last trip to the mountains.

results.title: Hold on to Your Music - A Mother's Legacy
results.original_title: Hold on to Your Music - A Mother's Legacy
results.overview: Three generations of Jewish women bound by music and trauma navigate the legacy of the Holocaust, from Vienna to London to Los Angeles, in a quest for redemption.

results.title: The Wandering Creature (And Other Tales)
results.overview: Writer/director Christopher R. Mihm takes a stab (pun intended) at an anthology movie in the vein of "Twilight Zone: The Movie," "Trilogy of Terror," and "Creepshow," albeit in his signature retro-B-movie style! In a series of linked, short tales-of-horror, an unmanned spacecraft returning from the asteroid Vesta breaks up upon re-entry into the Earth's atmosphere and scatters sample containers across Phantom Lake County! Not-so-unexpectedly, contact with the mysterious, otherworldly contents of these canisters creates a whole host of terrifying creatures—like mushroom monsters, killer garden gnomes, and more!

results.title: Reminiscence
results.overview: After losing his girlfriend in a car crash, a teenage boy recalls old memories.

results.title: Once a Week for Life
results.overview: NYPD Lt. Adam Galanis leads the Fugitive Task Force as he tumbles through a merciless life while balancing on a razors edge. Adam fights personal demons and addictions when he's forced to take revenge on plotting traitors and the mafia who are trying to kill him.

results.title: If You Are Reading This...
results.overview: Cassandra travels to Philadelphia in search of her brother, but instead finds a phylactery she must destroy. Cosmic horror descends upon her as her mission is impeded by a crawling force dragging her into madness. As she begins to understand what is happening, she becomes a victim of the same celestial force that made her brother vanish. Trapped with nowhere to go, she is nevertheless on the path to solving the mystery.

results.title: GANGSTALKER!
results.overview: A young reptilian is sent to earth on a mission to hunt incels.

results.title: We Dream in Colour
results.overview: In a sleepless city hooked on engineered dreams, Lola enters a lucid simulation and falls for an artificial companion designed to fulfil her every need.

results.title: Sudesha
results.overview: The story of a woman living in a village in the lower Himalayas. In this area, people depend entirely on the forest for their daily needs of firewood, food and water. But the forests have been destroyed by powerful timber traders. And along with the forest, the livelihood of the people has been greatly altered. The women of this region played an active role in the "Chipkow Movement". Sudesha was imprisoned for her protest.

results.title: Bilal Hassani, bats-toi comme une fille mon fils
results.original_title: Bilal Hassani, bats-toi comme une fille mon fils
results.overview: The general public discovered Bilal Hassani during Eurovision 2019 with his song "Roi" (King), a true anthem to diversity that sparked waves of both love and hatred on social media. Very quickly, the young man courageously tackled the question of gender identity in a personal and artistic exploration, not hesitating to share his doubts, his wounds, and his own evolution with us. This documentary sets out to embrace several deeply resonant themes: homosexuality, homophobia, cyberbullying and justice, racism as well as Moroccan roots, love and the choice of a mother who frees herself from cultural weight for her son's fulfillment, celebrity, and of course, identity and gender.

results.title: Katha Na Ma A U

results.overview: After mysteriously disappearing from his wealthy family’s estate, a young boy seeks refuge in a small rural village with new friends. What first appears to be a peaceful community soon reveals a dark secret: a deceptive cult leader and her followers are manipulating the villagers through black magic, and false promises.

results.title: Zoners
results.overview: A desperate young woman is forced to drive a mercenary and a stolen alien device through a land infested with monsters.
